source_text: De Cinaeis: stabile est habitaculum tuum; et si fuerit in captivitatem, Quirenaeos captivos ducet.
pass_a_gloss: Concerning Kenites: stable is dwelling your; and if it-will-be into captivity, Assyrians captives will-lead.
pass_b_english: On the Kenites: your dwelling is firm; yet if taken captive, Asshur shall lead captives away.
